cohort: 55 patients who developed HELLP syndrome or partial HELLP syndrome at Maharishi Markendeshwar Institute of Medical Sciences and Research (MMIMSR), Mullana, Ambala, Haryana, India
finding: The prevalence of HELLP syndrome was 1.83% among admitted pregnant patients, with the majority developing the condition between 32-36 weeks gestation, resulting in a maternal morbidity rate of 34.54% and a prematurity rate of 76.36%, with no maternal deaths.
